positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description:
Developing Automotive Infotainment Products.

Architect / System Lead for large format portrait HMI demo concept for major European automaker. (Java, C#,  C++, Qt 3D Studio)

Architect / System Lead for Multi-Screen Digital Cockpit proof of concept for major Japanese automaker. (Java, C#, Unity, Android)

Architect / System Lead for 2018 CES Mini Cooper Entry Level Digital Cockpit. Won Reddot Award for User Interface Design (Java, C#, Unity, Linux, Qt)

Evaluated Kanzi and Qt 3D Studio environments for delivering an embedded cluster HMI. 

Integrated Qt5.4 onto Freescale iMX6Q-based car infotainment platform. Analyzed bus loading and performance when running OpenGL animations under Wayland and EGLFS to solve performance issues. (Linux, Wayland, OpenGL)

Architect and development lead for Windows-based in car infotainment demonstration for top-tier auto manufacturer. (C#, Visual Studio 2015, Enterprise Architect, iMX6, Qt) 

Architecture work for HMI technology for Harman's next-generation high-end infotainment platform. Particularly HTML5 support for the platform. Exploring methods to keep state information out of the HMI code.

positions.title: Senior Embedded Software Engineer
positions.locationName: San Diego County, California, United States
positions.description: Developing Automotive Infotainment Products. Became Harman.

positions.title: Software Engineering
positions.description:
Tri-Mate Sports - Video Helmet – DaVinci (DM365, ARM9 core) based wearable camera with WiFi and Bluetooth. I was the sole software developer on this project. I evaluated and chose the DM365 processor, producing hardware block diagrams of multiple optional configurations. I performed initial board bring up and debug. Brought up Linux system. I customized the bootloader for a new NAND flash. I also customized the Linux Kernel for the specific peripheral mix the project was using. I modified the CCD camera driver for a newer sensor that had higher resolution. Wrote button/voice prompt UI with optional graphical menu component including 900Mhz radio controls, MP3 player, voice recorder and camera functions. Configured system to catch USB On-The-Go (USB OTG) plug notifications so that the storage space was dismounted internally and then mounted by a PC.  I also implemented firmware for a hand-held 900Mhz digital two-way radio on TMS320C2810 DSP processor using DSPBios. (Linux, DSPBios, C/C++, QT, GStreamer, Kernel Drivers)

Tri-Mate Sports - OxyStrap – Android and iPhone app for athletic performance data gathering from headband that that contains pulse oximetry sensors. Reported Oxygen saturation, pulse and body temp, as well as distance covered, calories expended, average speed, etc. Used text-to-voice to audibly report data. I consulted on the hardware design, and evaluated and chose the Bluetooth module. (Android, Java, iOS, Objective C, Bluetooth LE)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
DECE - Ultraviolet – Developed testing suites for verifying Ultraviolet media files and online account operations for device manufacturers, retailers and studios. C#/.NET GUI for running online API testing, test authoring, and test results with a SQL server backend. Wrote procedures for managing SSL certificates. Wrote WCF (Windows Communication Foundation) based proxy server to stand in front of the coordinator and verify authored test sequences and post results to SQL database for official certification of third party implementations. Wrote C++ app for parsing and verifying Ultraviolet files (segmented MP4), AVC streams, and subtitles. (Ultraviolet, Linux, Windows, Java, Perl, C#, .NET, AVC, SSL/TLS)
TiVo: Fix and extend various HPK (Hardware Porting Kit) utilities and incorporate them into an HPK Validation Suite suitable for OEMs to test their HPK implementations.  (Linux, C/C++)
Nagravision - DVR development. Developed requirements for new DVR function on existing set-top box platform. Developed requirements specification and User Interface Spec. Wrote DVR middleware including trickplay and CA interfaced to the Broadcom Nexus/Magnum API, Created a new Live TV buffer/navigation module that addressed circular buffer patent concerns. (Linux, C/C++, Broadcom 7401/5)
Thales - In Flight Entertainment system: Debugging and support for video driver, USB subsystem, and middleware. I previously did design and implementation on this system at CalAmp (below) (C/C++, USB, Video capture/overlay, PPC, MontaVista Linux) 
TiVo - Linux-based social networking device: Object oriented framework. I worked on VOIP (Asterisk) and Video Display module. (Linux, C/C++, Intel SOCs, Canmore, Sodaville, Agile)
Windows Service to support message passing to and from a USB bulk device (Cable Tuning Adapter) to a uPnP device. (Visual C++, uPnP)

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description: In Flight Entertainment system: Debugging and support for video driver, USB subsystem, and middleware. (USB, Video capture/overlay, PPC, MontaVista Linux)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Thales - In Flight Entertainment system: Based on an existing Linux-based set-top box platform, ported a frame driver for a new video display chip. Developed drivers for 2D acceleration on QT/Embedded, added support for numerous LCD displays, touch screen, button inputs, temperature and voltage sensors, digital video capture/overlay, ALSA sound, Ethernet, and HDTV DAC. Video player application using QT. Firmware for Atmel ARM based IR keyboard/game controller. (PPC, C/C++, MontaVista Linux, Qt Embedded)
IBM – Linux-based set-top box reference platform: Ported OpenBIOS (CPU init, Ethernet and flash boot code) and wrote low-level diagnostics firmware for PPC-based digital video set-top box. Bootloader for Linux kernel. (PPC405, C, GNU toolchain)
Ported Windows CE .NET to two ARM based and one XScale based tablet devices. Worked on initial board startup including verification of SDRAM and flash, and wrote a diagnostic monitor. Implemented boot ROM code for booting Windows CE from Ethernet and flash. Ported the PC Card driver, PCI bridge driver, and power management.  (StrongARM, XScale, Windows CE .NET, Windows CE 3)
Hardware/Software Specification for a Linux-based Digital Video Recorder platform. Responsibilities included component choices, and software architecture. (x86, Linux)
Software Developer for the ICEBox Internet Appliance. Helped develop and maintain software architecture. Designed and coded field software update process. VideoCD player application. Integrated C161/Zoran based DVD player. (Hitachi SH-3, Infineon C161, VxWorks, Tasking C161 compiler)
Firmware for car tracking module. Included GSM and GPS. Firmware written in Java for a Siemens GSM module.  
Ported DivX Networks ActiveMovie codec to Windows CE. (x86, Windows CE.NET)
Wrote America Online gateway software for Eudora email. This program creates MIME messages and attachments. It also translates HTML tags for display by Eudora and the AOL client software. (PC/Windows NT4.0, Visual C++, MFC)

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Technical strategist for all of IVID’s business areas. Researched new technology solutions and developed showcase demonstrations. Architect and Lead Developer for World Book Multimedia Encyclopedia, DOS, Windows, and Macintosh versions. Developed and implemented full text retrieval system, time searching feature, media browser, and atlas.
Designed and implemented transactional kiosk systems for Price/Costco. These systems include high quality photographs, end-user maintainable inventory database and nightly updates of products, media and pricing. 300+ kiosks operating for 5 years in 40 locations.
Created development platform for interactive training department using Visual Basic. This approach helped earn single source status from Ford Motor Company.
Developed software for exhibits at Scripps Aquarium.
